Puesto at the Headquarters (Gaslamp) - A modern taco restaurant just outside Seaport Village, known for its classic tacos and vibrant outdoor patio. (789 W Harbor Dr Suite 155)

Nolita Hall (Little Italy) - A unique venue with tasty sharing plates and a flight tracker board for plane enthusiasts. (2305 India St)

Valle - Focuses on contemporary Mexican food with a seasonal menu of Baja cuisine in Oceanside.

Market Restaurant & Bar - Known for its fresh and inventive menu, ideal for a special night out with meat-forward dishes.

Check-in and Check-out.placeholder_text: Backup key location, backup code, etc.
Check-in and Check-out.response_text: Only to be provided if the guest states that the door code is not working. Always confirm they are at the correct unit prior to providing backup lockbox code. There is a backup lockbox located on the railing closest to the unit door. The code is 1619. This contains a physical key which will allow them to manually unlock the door.

Check-in and Check-out.placeholder_text: e.g The lockbox can be hard to pull open. It might require some force.
Check-in and Check-out.response_text: For the unit door, the guest needs to tap the lock interface with their palm prior to entering code. If the lock interface does not light up, it may be out of battery and they will need to use the backup key in the lockbox.

Check-in and Check-out.placeholder_text: e.g. Yes, but only if requested in advance and if there is no other booking on the same day
Check-in and Check-out.question_text: Do you allow early check-in or late check-out?
Check-in and Check-out.response_text: For early check-in, the answer should always be that they can drop their bags off early (any time after 12pm) if they’d like and stay if they find the unit is clean when they arrive. The host will need to check the schedule when they’re back online, but we are unable to guarantee an early check-in if there is a guest checking out on the same day. If the guest has not yet booked and is inquiring about late check-out, the answer is no. We do not allow late checkouts if requested on the day of checkout. If requested the night before, you can tell the guest it’s highly unlikely but we can get back to them around 9-9:30am the next morning (the host needs to check the cleaner’s schedule) with a potential short extension (max up to 11am), but no guarantees. If requested several days in advance you can tell them to check back in with us the day before they check out so we can check with the cleaning team, but no guarantees of late checkout.
